items.title_zh: 来自安得拉邦的鹦鹉嘴公鸡在鸡选美比赛中大放异彩
items.title_en: Parrot Beak Roosters From Andhra Pradesh Shine at Beauty Contest for Chickens
items.summary_zh: 赛亚德·巴沙表示，饲养鹦鹉嘴公鸡，让它们参加选美比赛，是一项艰巨的任务。他说，他们将为母鸡提供具有营养价值的特殊饮食。
items.summary_en: Sayyad Basha said that it is a herculean task in growing parrot beak roosters to make them participate in a beauty pageant. He said they will have a special diet for the hens with nutritional values.

items.title_zh: RCB 的丹麦人 Sait Aka Mr Nags 已经赢得了 IPL 奖杯，这是证据
items.title_en: Danish Sait Aka Mr Nags of RCB Has Already Won an IPL Trophy, Here's Proof
items.summary_zh: 丹麦赛特（Danish Sait），也被称为纳格斯先生，最近在推特上发布了一张自己坐在 IPL 奖杯上的照片，证明他已经赢得了冠军，这与其他 RCB 明星不同。
items.summary_en: Danish Sait, who is also known as Mr. Nags, recently tweeted a photo of himself sitting with an IPL trophy, proving that he has already won one, unlike the other RCB stars.

items.title_zh: 泰米尔纳德邦“90 年代儿童商店”提供甜蜜美食，2000 名儿童排队等候
items.title_en: Tamil Nadu '90s Kids Shop' Serves Sweet Delights, 2000 Children Queue Up
items.summary_zh: 为了扭转当前的趋势，为那些渴望再次体验黄金时代的人们开设了一家糖果店。
items.summary_en: In a bid to reverse the current trend, a candy shop has been established for those who desire to once more experience the golden era.

items.title_zh: 女性对 19 世纪 Qawwali 的看法，称赞 Kanhaiya 是“Bahut Khoob”
items.title_en: Woman's Take On 19th Century Qawwali Praising Kanhaiya Is 'Bahut Khoob'
items.summary_zh: 这首特定的 thumri，Kanhayya Yaad Hai，是由 Nawab Sadiq Jung Bahadur Hilm 在 19 世纪按照奉爱传统创作的。
items.summary_en: This specific thumri, Kanhayya Yaad Hai, was composed in the bhakti tradition by Nawab Sadiq Jung Bahadur Hilm in the 19th century.
